title.value: An Act to Amend the Laws Relating to the Prevention of Perfluoroalkyl and Polyfluoroalkyl Substances Pollution
title.provenance: An Act to Amend the Laws Relating to the Prevention of Perfluoroalkyl and Polyfluoroalkyl Substances Pollution

status.provenance: Be it enacted by the People of the State of Maine as follows:

pfas_definition.provenance: “Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances” or “PFAS” means substances that include any member of the class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: 5. Prohibition on sale of products containing intentionally added PFAS.

date.provenance: Effective January 1, 2023, a person may not sell, offer for sale or distribute for sale in this State a carpet or rug that contains intentionally added PFAS.

who.provenance: A person may not sell, offer for sale or distribute for sale in this State a carpet or rug that contains intentionally added PFAS.

action.provenance: A person may not sell, offer for sale or distribute for sale in this State a carpet or rug that contains intentionally added PFAS.

products.provenance: a carpet or rug that contains intentionally added PFAS

value: carpet or rug intended solely for outdoor use
carpet or rug intended solely for use inside an aircraft, train, watercraft, automobile, light duty truck, van, bus or any other vehicle
exceptions.provenance: The prohibition under this paragraph does not apply to the sale, offer for sale or resale distribution for sale of a used carpet or rug. "Carpet or rug" does not include: (1) A carpet or rug intended solely for outdoor use; (2) A carpet or rug intended solely for use inside an aircraft, train, watercraft, automobile, light duty truck, van, bus or any other vehicle

intentionally_added.provenance: a carpet or rug that contains intentionally added PFAS

type.provenance: 5. Prohibition on sale of products containing intentionally added PFAS.

date.provenance: Effective January 1, 2026, a person may not sell, offer for sale or distribute for sale in this State: (1) A cleaning product containing intentionally added PFAS; (2) A cookware product containing intentionally added PFAS; (3) A cosmetic product containing intentionally added PFAS; (4) Dental floss containing intentionally added PFAS; (5) A juvenile product containing intentionally added PFAS; (6) A menstruation product containing intentionally added PFAS; (7) A textile article containing intentionally added PFAS.

who.provenance: A person may not sell, offer for sale or distribute for sale in this State: (1) A cleaning product containing intentionally added PFAS; (2) A cookware product containing intentionally added PFAS; (3) A cosmetic product containing intentionally added PFAS; (4) Dental floss containing intentionally added PFAS; (5) A juvenile product containing intentionally added PFAS; (6) A menstruation product containing intentionally added PFAS; (7) A textile article containing intentionally added PFAS.

action.provenance: A person may not sell, offer for sale or distribute for sale in this State: (1) A cleaning product containing intentionally added PFAS; (2) A cookware product containing intentionally added PFAS; (3) A cosmetic product containing intentionally added PFAS; (4) Dental floss containing intentionally added PFAS; (5) A juvenile product containing intentionally added PFAS; (6) A menstruation product containing intentionally added PFAS; (7) A textile article containing intentionally added PFAS.

products.provenance: (1) A cleaning product containing intentionally added PFAS; (2) A cookware product containing intentionally added PFAS; (3) A cosmetic product containing intentionally added PFAS; (4) Dental floss containing intentionally added PFAS; (5) A juvenile product containing intentionally added PFAS; (6) A menstruation product containing intentionally added PFAS; (7) A textile article containing intentionally added PFAS.

value: outdoor apparel for severe wet conditions
textile article that is included in or a component part of a watercraft, aircraft or motor vehicle
exceptions.provenance: The prohibition under this paragraph does not include: (a) Outdoor apparel for severe wet conditions; or (b) A textile article that is included in or a component part of a watercraft, aircraft or motor vehicle, including an off-highway vehicle; The prohibition under this paragraph does not apply to any of the products listed in subparagraphs (1) to (9) that are sold, offered for sale or distributed for sale in used condition.

type.provenance: 5. Prohibition on sale of products containing intentionally added PFAS.

date.provenance: Effective January 1, 2030, a person may not sell, offer for sale or distribute for sale in this State any product that contains intentionally added PFAS that is not already prohibited from sale, offer for sale or distribution for sale pursuant to paragraph A, B, B-1, B-2 or C

action.provenance: A person may not sell, offer for sale or distribute for sale in this State any product that contains intentionally added PFAS that is not already prohibited from sale, offer for sale or distribution for sale pursuant to paragraph A, B, B-1, B-2 or C

value: cooling, heating, ventilation, air conditioning and refrigeration equipment
exceptions.provenance: The prohibition under this paragraph does not apply to: (1) Any such products sold, offered for sale or distributed for sale in used condition; (2) Cooling, heating, ventilation, air conditioning and refrigeration equipment, including parts and other servicing needs for such equipment; or (3) Refrigerants, foams and aerosol propellants that are listed as acceptable, acceptable subject to use conditions or acceptable subject to narrowed use limits by the United States Environmental Protection Agency

currently_unavoidable.provenance: unless the department has determined by rule that the use of PFAS in the product is a currently unavoidable use
